results.title: Authentication - Datadog API
results.snippet: All requests to Datadog’s API must be authenticated. Requests that write data require reporting access and require an API key. Requests that read data require full access and also require an application key. Note: All Datadog API clients are configured by default to consume Datadog US site APIs.
